question:
The average of four consecutive odd natural numbers is eight less than the average of three consecutive even natural numbers. If the sum of these three even numbers is equal to the sum of the above four odd numbers, then the average of the four original odd numbers is:

(CHSL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 24.

Let the average of 4 odd numbers = x

Then, the average of 3 even numbers = x + 8

Sum of 4 odd numbers = 4x

Sum of 3 even numbers = 3(x + 8) = 3x + 24

⇒ 4x = 3x + 24

⇒ x = 24

question:
The average of the squares of four consecutive odd natural numbers is 201. The average of 7 times the largest number and 3 times the smallest number is:

(CHSL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 76.

Let the four consecutive odd natural numbers be: (x - 3), (x - 1), (x + 1), (x + 3)

⇒ 201 = \({(x-3)^2+(x-1)^2+(x+1)^2+(x+3)^2}\over4\)

⇒ x2 + 9 - 6x + x2 + 1 - 2x + x2 + 1 + 2x + x2 + 9 + 6x = 804

⇒ 4x2 + 20 = 804

⇒ 4x2 = 784

⇒ x2 = 196

⇒ x = 14

Required average = \({7(x+3)+3(x-3)}\over2\) = \({7\times17+3\times11}\over2\) = \({119+33}\over2\) = \(152\over2\) = 76

⇒ x2 + 9 - 6x + x2 + 1 - 2x + x2 + 1 + 2x + x2 + 9 + 6x = 804

⇒ 4x2 + 20 = 804

⇒ 4x2 = 784

⇒ x2 = 196

आवश्यक औसत  = \({7(x+3)+3(x-3)}\over2\) = \({7\times17+3\times11}\over2\) = \({119+33}\over2\) = \(152\over2\) = 76

question:
While listing N consecutive even numbers for determining their average, the last number, by mistake, got replaced by the next odd number, and thereby the average turned out to be more than the desired value by 0.0125. What is the value of N?

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 80.

Last number is = Nth + 1

For the difference in average change by \(1\over N\)

⇒ \(1\over N\) = 0.0125

⇒ N = 80

⇒ \(1\over N\) = 0.0125

question:

question:
The average of seven consecutive odd numbers (in increasing order) is k. If the next four consecutive odd numbers are included, then the average of all the numbers is:

(SP Phase-8)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. k + 4.

Let the numbers be: (x - 6), (x - 4), (x - 2), x, (x + 2), (x + 4), (x + 6)

k = \({(x-6)+(x-4)+(x-2)+x+(x+2)+(x+4)+(x+6)}\over7\)

⇒ 7k = 7x

⇒ k = x

Next four numbers = (k + 8), (k + 10), (k + 12), (k + 14)

New average = \({(k-6)+(k-4)+(k-2)+k+(k+2)+(k+4)+(k+6)+(k+8)+(k+10)+(k+12)+(k+14)}\over11\)

⇒ \({11k+44}\over11\) = k + 4

question:
Out of five numbers A, B, C, D, and E, the average of the first four numbers A, B, C, and D is greater than the average of the last four numbers B, C, D, and E by 35. The value of \({A-E}\over7\)  is:

(SP Phase-9)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 20.

⇒ \({A+B+C+D}\over4\) - \({B+C+D+E}\over4\) = 35

⇒ A + B + C + D - B - C - D - E = 35 × 4

⇒ A - E = 140

⇒ \({A-E}\over7\) = \(140\over7\) = 20
question_hi:

(SP Phase-9)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 20 है।

⇒ \({A+B+C+D}\over4\) - \({B+C+D+E}\over4\) = 35

⇒ A + B + C + D - B - C - D - E = 35 × 4

⇒ A - E = 140

⇒ \({A-E}\over7\) = \(140\over7\) = 20

question:

question:
There are 32 consecutive natural numbers. The average of the first 13 numbers is x. What is the average of the next 19 numbers?  

(MTS 2021)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. x + 16.

Average of n consecutive natural numbers = (n + 1)

∴  Average of 32 consecutive natural numbers = 33

Average of the first 13 numbers = x

∴  7th number = x

If we calculate the average of the next 19 numbers, the average will be the 10th number.

∴  Average = 13 + 10 = 23th number

∴ 7th number = x

23th number = x + 16

∴ 32 क्रमागत प्राकृतिक संख्याओं का औसत = 33

पहली 13 संख्याओं का औसत = x

∴ 7वीं संख्या = x

यदि हम अगली 19 संख्याओं का औसत निकालें, तो औसत 10वीं संख्या होगी।

∴ औसत = 13 + 10 = 23वीं संख्या

∴ 7वीं संख्या = x

23वीं संख्या = x + 16

question:
There are 17 consecutive odd numbers. If the average of the first 11 numbers is x, then what is the average of the last 6 numbers?

(SSC GD 2024)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. x + 17.

Average of n consecutive odd numbers = n

∴ Average of 17 numbers = 17

Sum of 17 numbers = 17 × 17 = 289

Average of first 11 numbers = x = 11

Sum of these 11 numbers = 11 × 11 = 121

∴ sum of the last 6 numbers = 289 - 121 = 168

Average of last 6 numbers = \(168\over6\) = 28

⇒ 28 = 11 + 17 = x + 17
question_hi:

(SSC GD 2024)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात x + 17 है।

​n लगातार विषम संख्याओं का औसत = n

∴ 17 संख्याओं का औसत = 17

17 संख्याओं का योग = 17 × 17 = 289

पहली 11 संख्याओं का औसत = x = 11

इन 11 संख्याओं का योग = 11 × 11 = 121

∴ अंतिम 6 संख्याओं का योग = 289 - 121 = 168

अंतिम 6 संख्याओं का औसत = \(168\over6\) = 28

⇒ 28 = 11 + 17 = x + 17

question:
There are 120 hens in a poultry. Due to the addition of 140 more hens, the expenses of the poultry increased by ₹4050, while the average expenditure per hen diminished by ₹3. What was the original expenditure on the poultry?

(SSC GD 2024)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. ₹4140.

Let Average expenditure = ₹A

⇒ 120A + 4050 = 260 (A – 3)

⇒ 120A + 4050 = 260A – 780

⇒ 140A = 4830

⇒ A = \(4830\over140\) = \(69\over2\)

∴ Original expenditure = 120A = 120 × \(69\over2\) = 4140
question_hi:

(SSC GD 2024)
solution_hi:

​मान लीजिए औसत व्यय = ₹A

⇒ 120A + 4050 = 260 (A – 3)

⇒ 120A + 4050 = 260A – 780

⇒ 140A = 4830

⇒ A = \(4830\over140\) = \(69\over2\)

∴ मूल व्यय = 120A = 120 × \(69\over2\) = 4140

question:
The average of eleven numbers is 54. The average of the first four numbers is 48, and that of the next four numbers is 25% more than the average of the first four. The ninth number is 8 greater than the 11th number, and the 10th number is 4 greater than the 11th number. What is the average of the 9th and the 10th numbers?

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 56.

Sum of 11 numbers = 11 × 54 = 594

Sum of first 4 numbers = 4 × 48 = 192

Average of next 4 numbers (5th to 8th) = 25% more than 48

⇒ 48 + 25% of 48 = 48 + 12 = 60

Sum = 4 × 60 = 240

Let, 11th number = x

9th number = x + 8

10th number = x + 4

⇒ 594 = 192 + 240 + (x + 8) + (x + 4) + x

⇒ 594 = 432 + 3x + 12

⇒ 3x = 150

⇒ x = 50

Average = \({2x+12}\over2\) = \(112\over2\) = 56
question_hi:

question:

question_hi:

question:

question:
The mean of 100 numbers is 51. It was discovered that three numbers, which should have been 50, 70, and 60, were wrongly read as 40, 20, and 50, respectively. The correct mean is:

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 51.7.

Mean of 100 numbers = 51

Sum = 51 × 100 = 5100

Added numbers = 50, 70, 60

Misread numbers = 40, 20, 50,

Difference = (50 + 70 + 60) – (40 + 20 + 50) = +70

New sum = 5100 + 70 = 5170

New mean = \(5170\over100\) = 51.7

Alternatively:-

Correct mean = 51 + \(70\over100\) = 51.7
question_hi:
100 संख्याओं का माध्य 51 है। यह पाया गया कि तीन संख्याएँ, जो 50, 70 और 60 होनी चाहिए थीं, उन्हें गलती से क्रमशः 40, 20 और 50 पढ़ लिया गया। सही माध्य है:

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 51.7 है।

​100 संख्याओं का माध्य = 51

योग = 51 × 100 = 5100

जोड़ी गई संख्याएँ = 50, 70, 60

गलत पढ़ी गई संख्याएँ = 40, 20, 50,

अंतर = (50 + 70 + 60) – (40 + 20 + 50) = +70

नया योग = 5100 + 70 = 5170

नया माध्य = \(5170\over100\) = 51.7

​वैकल्पिक रूप से:-

सही माध्य = 51 + \(70\over100\) = 51.7

question:

solution:

question_hi:

शेष रन = 272 - 72 = 200

शेष मैच में औसत रन रेट = \(200\over40\) = 5

question:
The batting average for 27 innings of a cricket player is 47 runs. His highest score in an innings exceeds his lowest score by 157 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average score of the remaining 25 innings is 42 runs. Find his highest score in an innings.

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 188.

Total runs in 27 innings = 27 × 47 = 1269

Total runs in 25 innings = 25 × 42 = 1050

⇒ H + L = 1269 – 1050

⇒ H + L = 219

⇒ H – L = 157

⇒ H = \({219+157}\over2\) = 188
question_hi:
एक क्रिकेट खिलाड़ी की 27 पारियों का बल्लेबाजी औसत 47 रन है। एक पारी में उसका उच्चतम स्कोर उसके न्यूनतम स्कोर से 157 रन अधिक है। यदि इन दो पारियों को छोड़ दिया जाए, तो शेष 25 पारियों का औसत स्कोर 42 रन है। एक पारी में उसका उच्चतम स्कोर ज्ञात कीजिए।

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 188 है।

27 पारियों में कुल रन = 27 × 47 = 1269

25 पारियों में कुल रन = 25 × 42 = 1050

 ⇒ H + L = 1269 – 1050

⇒ H + L = 219

⇒ H – L = 157

⇒ H = \({219+157}\over2\) = 188

question:

10वीं पारी में उसके रन = 58 + 10 × 3 = 88 होना चाहिए

question:
Ram has an average score of 65 runs in 19 innings in cricket matches. Find out how many runs are to be scored by him in the 20th innings to raise the average score to 67.

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:

Total score in 20 innings = 20 × 67 = 1340

This score in 20th innings = 1340 – 1235 = 105

Alternatively:-

His score in the 20th innings = 65 + 20 × (67 – 65)

⇒ 65 + 20 × 2 = 105
question_hi:
राम ने क्रिकेट मैचों में 19 पारियों में 65 रन का औसत स्कोर बनाया है। पता लगाइए कि 20वीं पारी में उसे कितने रन बनाने होंगे ताकि औसत स्कोर 67 हो जाए।

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 105 है।

19 पारियों में कुल स्कोर = 19 × 65 = 1235

20 पारियों में कुल स्कोर = 20 × 67 = 1340

20वीं पारी में यह स्कोर = 1340 – 1235 = 105

वैकल्पिक रूप से:-

20वीं पारी में उसका स्कोर = 65 + 20 × (67 – 65)

⇒ 65 + 20 × 2 = 105

question:

question_hi:

solution_hi:

औसत = \(41\over2\) = 20.5

question:
A batsman scores 92 runs in the 15th inning and thus increases his average by 4. What is his average after the 15th inning?

(CPO 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 36.

Let average in 14 innings = x

⇒ Total runs in 14 innings = 14 × x = 14x

⇒ 15 × (x + 4) = 14x + 92

⇒ 15x + 60 – 14x = 92

⇒ x = 32

Average after 15th inning = 32 + 4 = 36

Alternatively:-

Deviation after 15th innings = +4 × 15 = +60

Earlier average = 92 – 60 = 32

New average = 32 + 4 = 36
question_hi:
एक बल्लेबाज 15वीं पारी में 92 रन बनाता है और इस प्रकार उसका औसत 4 से बढ़ जाता है। 15वीं पारी के बाद उसका औसत क्या है?

solution_hi:

⇒ 14 पारियों में कुल रन = 14 × x = 14x

⇒ 15 × (x + 4) = 14x + 92

⇒ 15x + 60 – 14x = 92

⇒ x = 32

15वीं पारी के बाद औसत = 32 + 4 = 36

वैकल्पिक रूप से:-

15वीं पारी के बाद विचलन = +4 × 15 = +60

पहले का औसत = 92 – 60 = 32

नया औसत = 32 + 4 = 36

(SP Phase-9)
solution:
